thought: Dusk on Throop Ave, sky deep blue with pink clouds, lamps coming on. A white SUV is parked about five metres to my left. I'll turn to it and walk up to the door.
I'm in the SUV. The radio shows BK House with no sets, and the console is complaining about a blocked fetch. I'll pull out and roll up the avenue.
Doing about 24 km/h with a car five metres ahead. I'll hold the throttle and see whether the traffic moves. If it doesn't I'll go round it.

The street opens up ahead with lit brick walls and a lamp line up the avenue, but the car in front is still crawling, and a wanted star has just lit on the HUD. I'll give a small swing left to get past it and open up.
I'm clear and doing 45 km/h. The avenue ahead has a row of lit shopfronts, a deli sign on the right, and a yellow beam of light marking a Block Party. I'll keep the foot down straight up the avenue.

I've drifted onto the pavement outside a pharmacy, and a Block Party mission has just started on its own from the beam I drove through. The goal is to borrow a speaker from Garvey Cutz, with a two-minute timer. I'll back off the kerb and find the road.
